999008199.text:
さて、錬金術士どもを捕らえたところ、
望外の旧友まで釣れたわけだが……

localizations.en: Well, well. We caught ourselves some alchemists, but it seems we've also netted some unexpected old friends...

999008199.text:
牢まで待たなくていい。聞きたいなら教えてやる。
鏑矢、お前は騙されているんだ

localizations.en: There's no need for that. If it's the truth you want, Kaburaya, right now will do. In short, you're being deceived.

999008199.text: 悪の陰陽師コウセン、こいつが用いた玉涎香によって！

localizations.en: By that vile diviner Kosen, using that Jade Nectar!

999008199.text:
コウセン、お前が余に献上した香、
念のため改めさせてもらうぞ

localizations.en: Kosen... that incense you gifted me... I'll examine it once more, just to be certain.

999008199.text: 鏑矢様……

今は袂を分かったとはいえ、旧き友人の言……
黙って見過ごすわけにもいくまい

localizations.en: Though we may have parted ways, these are the words of an old friend. I cannot simply ignore them.

999008199.text:
気になるのでしたら、どうぞいくらでも。
心ゆくまでお調べくださいませ

localizations.en: If it concerns you, then by all means examine it to your heart's content. I welcome your thorough investigation.

999008199.text:
すまんな。それと、捕らえた者たちからも、色々と話を
聞いておきたいところではあるが……

localizations.en: My apologies. And I would like to question these prisoners we've captured at length, but...

999008199.text:
鏑矢様は都からやって来た巡見使をもてなす宴に
ご出席いただかなければ

localizations.en: You must attend the banquet to entertain the inspectors who have arrived from the capital.

999008199.text:
ああ、そうだな。領主直々にもてなすことで
都の連中の顔を立ててやらねば……面倒な奴らだ

localizations.en: Ah, right. I must personally host them to play along with those capital bureaucrats... What a tedious bunch.

999008199.text:
取り調べは後日に回す。
コウセン……くれぐれも丁重に扱え。今はまだ、な

localizations.en: The interrogation can wait until later. Kosen... treat them with courtesy. For now, at least.

999008199.text:
承知しております。あの中には私とは違えど
凄まじい力を持っている人間もございます

localizations.en: Of course. Among them are individuals with tremendous power, different though it may be from mine.

999008199.text:
特にあの、異邦人と思しき錬金術士……葬り去るには
惜しい逸材です。できるなら家臣に取り立てたいほど

localizations.en: Especially that alchemist who appears to be a wanderer... Such talent would be wasted if we simply executed her. I would even consider making her a retainer.

999008199.text: 異邦人、とはなんだ？

localizations.en: A wanderer? What do you mean by that?

999008199.text:
世界を越えて訪れた者を指す言葉でございます。
大陸のほうでは時折見られるとか

localizations.en: It refers to those who have traveled from beyond this world. They can occasionally be found on the continent, I'm told.

999008199.text: 世界を越えて……？　おいおい、心がときめくな

localizations.en: From beyond this world...? My, you've piqued my interest.

999008199.text:
伝え聞くところによると、この世の他にも人が暮らす、
異なる世界があるそうでございます

localizations.en: From what I understand, there exist other worlds where people dwell, separate from our own.

999008199.text:
本当、なのでしょうか……
にわかには信じがたい話です……

localizations.en: Is that... really true? That's hard to believe...

999008199.text:
前の謁見ではそのようなこと、おくびにも
出さなかったではないか。小賢しい真似をする

localizations.en: You never mentioned anything of the sort during our previous audience.

999008199.text:
やはり詳しい話を聞かねばならんな。
それにしても別の世界とはなぁ

localizations.en: I'll definitely need to hear more details. But other worlds, you say...

999008199.text: ふふ……余の望む天下は思いのほか広いようだ

localizations.en: Hehe... It seems the realm I seek to conquer is larger than I imagined.

999008199.text:
大望を抱くその姿、まさに覇王の器でございますな。
ですが、今のところは巡検使のもてなしを……

localizations.en: Such grand ambitions truly befit a conqueror of your stature. But for now, we must attend to entertaining the inspectors...

999008199.text: 分かっている！

ああ、千歳は別に来なくてもいい。
奴らに染み付いた俗世の穢れが移ってしまう

localizations.en: Ah, Chitose, you can sit this one out. The worldly corruption clinging to those men might rub off on you.

999008199.text:
私は……
で、できる限り鏑矢様のおそばにいたいのです……

localizations.en: I... I want to stay by your side...

999008199.text:
まことに愛いな、千歳。
よし、ならば途中までは共に参ろう

localizations.en: How adorable you are, Chitose. Very well, then we shall go partway together.

999008199.text: ……思わぬ邪魔が入ってしまったが、問題ない

検分の結果など如何様にもできる上、
もし香を潰されたとしても、今ならば……

localizations.en: I can manipulate the examination results however I please, and even if the incense were to be destroyed, at this point...

999008199.text:
あの狂犬を飼い慣らす術は、
いくらでもあるのだ

localizations.en: I have countless ways to keep that mad dog on her leash.

999008199.text:
ご注進！　かの錬金術士の仲間と思われる者たちが
島内に侵入した模様！

localizations.en: Urgent report! Individuals believed to be companions of those alchemists have infiltrated the island!

999008199.text:
網にかかりおったか……
飛んで火に入る夏の虫よ！

localizations.en: So they've fallen into our trap... Like moths drawn to flame!
